text: In an elegant New York townhouse, the ancient vampire Miriam Blaylock and her cellist lover John pose as music teachers and [slash the throats of nightclub couples|threat|blood drinkers] with bladed ankh pendants. Two hundred years after she turned him, John begins to age by the day, learning [her promise was only half true|wrong|broken trust]: eternal life, without eternal youth. When he seeks help from the ageing researcher Sarah Roberts, Miriam [draws Sarah into a seduction|trigger|love and desire], while in the attic [her former lovers moan in their coffins|images|graves, coffins and funerals].
